definitions.gloss: imagawayaki; round filled cake; stuffed pancake
definitions.explanation: A round, flat cake made of batter cooked in a circular mold and filled with sweet red bean paste (or other fillings like custard cream or chocolate). A popular Japanese street food and festival snack.

examples.japanese: {今川焼|いまがわや}きを{買|か}った。
{焼|や}きたての{今川焼|いまがわや}きはおいしい。
お{祭|まつ}りの{屋台|やたい}で{今川焼|いまがわや}きを{食|た}べるのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: I look forward to eating imagawayaki at the festival food stalls.

notes: Named after the {今川|いまがわ}{橋|ばし} (Imagawa Bridge) area in Edo, where it is said to have originated. This food has many regional names across Japan: {大判焼|おおばんや}き (Kansai and other regions), {回転焼|かいてんや}き (Kansai), {太鼓焼|たいこや}き (some regions), {御座候|ござそうろう} (brand name popular in Kansai). The most common filling is {粒|つぶ}あん (chunky red bean paste) or こしあん (smooth red bean paste), but modern variations include カスタードクリーム (custard cream) and チョコレート (chocolate).
